interface.title: SoloLab — STIX · RPW · EPD Temporal Analysis Tool
interface.field: Heliophysics / solar physics (Solar Orbiter multi-instrument flare analysis)
interface.stage_of_work: data import, cleaning (background subtraction; the polluted-frequency filtering named in the README was not found as a control in the web UI) and exploratory visualisation and correlation of time series
interface.what_it_is_for: Import Solar Orbiter STIX X-ray, RPW radio and EPD particle data for one event, clean each instrument, preview it, and stack the instruments into one multi-panel plot sharing a time axis, plus STIX X-ray imaging.

data.note: No test files were available (browser_list_files returned an empty list), and the sandboxed server has no outbound network. All three server-side download paths failed with an error banner: STIX Data Center gave a proxy 'Tunnel connection failed: 403 Forbidden' (screens/007.webp), CDAWeb gave a urlopen 403 (screens/009.webp) and EPD gave 'HTTP Error 403: Forbidden' (screens/014.webp). No instrument was ever loaded, and every sidebar status chip stayed red with 'No data loaded'. I could only exercise the controls that work without data: dropdowns, mode toggles, and the band, frequency and contour table editors.

features.name: Editable band/range table modal
features.general: Open a small table of numeric ranges or levels, add, edit or delete rows, and confirm them for the next computation
features.specific: Set Energy Ranges (STIX Min/Max keV, on Plot Data and on STIX Imaging), Select Frequencies (RPW kHz), Set Contour Levels (% of peak): a Dash DataTable in a modal with Add row, × delete and Done. A summary under the button appears only on STIX Imaging (e.g. '30, 75, 90 %', '6-10, 12-25 keV'); the Plot Data tables show none. The Plot Data STIX ranges survived a page reload, but the STIX Imaging energy ranges went back to the defaults (6-10, 12-25, 32-60 keV)
steps: press the Set … button to open the modal
press Add row (it pre-fills a default value)
click a cell and type a new value
press × to drop a row
press Done; on STIX Imaging the summary text under the button updates
serves_tasks: Define the energy bands that get integrated into light curves
Pick the individual frequencies to draw as radio light curves
Define the contour levels drawn on the reconstructed image
Choose the energy bands to image

features.name: Instrument import panel: remote query → fetch → preview → LOAD
features.general: Ask a remote data archive for one instrument's measurements over a chosen period, fetch them to the server, look at them, and commit them to the session; a local file drop is the alternative
features.specific: Import STIX / RPW-HFR / RPW-TNR / EPD pages. Two query variants: archive search (STIX Data Center by date, HH:MM, duration 1 h / 3 h / 12 h / 1 day / 3 days / 7 days and xray-spec / xray-cpd; CDAWeb by year and month for RPW, then a results dropdown and Download Selected) and day query (EPD observation date, Electron/Proton, resample 30sec–10min, Download EPD Data). Then Preview Data / Plot Preview and LOAD; a FITS/CDF drop zone replaces the remote query
steps: fill the query form (date, time and duration; year and month; or date, species and resample)
choose the product type where offered
press 🔍 to search or Download EPD Data to fetch
for archive searches, pick a file from the results dropdown and press Download Selected
press Preview Data / Plot Preview
press LOAD to commit it
serves_tasks: Find an archived X-ray observation for a chosen time window on a remote archive
Look up which days a radio archive has data for in a given month
Request one day of particle flux for a chosen species and time resolution
